snippet.title: Bugscraper - Official Trailer (2025)
snippet.description:
Steam: https://s.team/a/2957130
itch.io: https://yolwoocle.itch.io/bugscraper
Website: https://bugscraper.net

Welcome to the Bugscraper.

Bugscraper is a solo or co-op roguelike shooter. As you climb toward your tyrannical boss's office, you'll battle floor after floor of enemies. Using a wide arsenal of weapons and upgrades, mow them down and aim for the top!

🐜 Play as Mio and his friends, in solo or in local co-op with up to 4 players.
🐛 Fight through a hundred waves packed with furious enemies and tough bosses.
🐝 Gather new weapons, drink up on helpful upgrades, and get ready for battle on the next floor!
🐞 Reach the top of the building and settle the score with your boss!
